# Amp fixtures

No Amp installation was available when this provider was written, so every file is
`synthetic_`, built from the thread shapes ccusage's reader documents. Text is `redacted`.
Replace with real threads before release (`docs/USER_ACTIONS.md`).

| File | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `synthetic_ledger_thread.json` | `usageLedger` entries; one joined to its message for cache counters, one pointing nowhere with an unpriced model |
| `synthetic_message_thread.json` | A thread from before the ledger: usage on assistant messages |
